SEGMENT 1 (playback order)
EP36:E12 0-2800 CAMERA: Wide shot of the wooden cabin interior. Alexander stands upright opposite his mother across the lantern-lit map.
EP36:E13 200-2700 ALEXANDER: "They knew where I was."
EP36:E14 2800-8200 CAMERA: Close-up on Alexander leaning over the table, his eyes locked onto his mother as suppressed rage surfaces.
EP36:E15 2900-8000 ALEXANDER: "My position was leaked to the French... before I could expose what I had discovered."
EP36:E16 8200-11100 CAMERA: Close-up of Alexander's mother clutching the collar of her dark cloak, her chest heaving with agony.
EP36:E17 8400-10900 ALEXANDER'S MOTHER: "They gave you to the enemy?"
EP36:E18 11100-15000 CAMERA: Medium close-up of Alexander straightening his posture, his jaw set hard.
EP36:E19 11200-13700 ALEXANDER: "They gave them my location."
EP36:E20 15000-18100 CAMERA: Extreme close-up on Alexander's eyes and scarred cheek, teeth bared in contempt.
EP36:E21 15400-17900 ALEXANDER: "They wanted the investigation buried."
EP36:E22 18100-20700 CAMERA: Medium close-up of Alexander's mother leaning over the map, her voice cracking.
EP36:E23 18300-20600 ALEXANDER'S MOTHER: "And when you disappeared...?"
EP36:E24 20700-24000 CAMERA: Close-up on Alexander, his voice low and cutting.
EP36:E25 20800-22900 ALEXANDER: "They declared me dead."
EP36:E26 24000-28000 CAMERA: Medium shot from the side of the wooden table as his mother brings both hands up to cover her mouth in overwhelmed grief.
EP36:E27 24500-27700 ALEXANDER: "They falsified what remained of the reports."
EP36:E28 24500-28000 ACTION: Alexander's mother presses her trembling hands against her lips, tears brimming in her eyes.
EP36:E29 28000-31000 CAMERA: Tight close-up on his mother weeping openly, her ring catching the warm lamplight as she lowers her hand to her heart.
EP36:E30 28200-31000 ALEXANDER'S MOTHER: "And Rupert took Ashbourne."

hook.reason: The opening line "They knew where I was." (200-2700ms) gives an immediate sense of threat and betrayal, and the tense staging over the map adds to it. The hook relies on a loaded line rather than shown events, so a first-time viewer has no idea who "they" are.

cliffhanger.reason: The clip ends on "And Rupert took Ashbourne." (28200-31000), a new reveal that is not explained, so the stakes stay open. It is not a conventional cliffhanger, because the reveal lands as a statement rather than a suspended action, and the implications of Ashbourne's loss are unclear.

missing_context: Who "they" are and which organisation or faction betrayed Alexander
What the "French" enemy relationship and Alexander's position being leaked mean
What Alexander discovered and what the "investigation" was
Who Alexander's mother is in relation to the conflict
Who Rupert is and why taking Ashbourne matters
What Ashbourne is (place, object, or person)
Why Alexander was declared dead and what the falsified reports concealed

emotion.reason: The clip builds from suppressed rage to contempt to the mother's open grief and weeping (E14-E29), so the emotional arc is clear even without context. The shared grief between mother and son carries the emotion.

weaknesses: Heavy reliance on undefined names and places (Rupert, Ashbourne, the French) reduces clarity for a first-time viewer
Dense expository dialogue delivers backstory without visual grounding
Mother's motivation and relationship to the plot are not established
Ending reveal is ambiguous and may read as a non-sequitur without prior context
Several camera descriptions repeat similar close-up framing, so the visual variety is limited
output.one_line_why_it_works: Escalating betrayal dialogue and a mother's visible grief build emotional pressure, and the closing mention of Ashbourne leaves a dangling stake that invites the viewer to ask what happens next.
